## Murmie 1.0.0
The first public release of Murmie, private voice dictation for your Mac.
- Double-tap Right ⌘, speak, tap Right ⌘ again, and your words are typed at the cursor. Esc cancels. Push-to-talk on Right ⌥ is optional. - Speech is turned into text on your Mac with NVIDIA Parakeet, Google Gemma, WhisperKit or Apple's speech engine. - Models download only when you choose them in setup or Settings. - Optional AI correction and Ask AI, off by default. Use on-device Gemma, Apple Intelligence, or your own cloud API key. - Murmie checks for updates about once a day; you can turn this off in Settings › About.
Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
